categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: PSBT handling is explicitly covered under wallet, and this directly modifies PSBT signing validation and UTXO pruning in src/psbt.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where valid PSBTs with 65-byte Taproot signatures fail validation with SIGHASH_MISMATCH and cannot be signed or finalized. According to issue #36507, SignPSBTInput erroneously rejected valid signatures when PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE was omitted, blocking completion of valid PSBT signing workflows.
